text:
sam: quick PSA: QA flagged that a tenant-scoped flag change accidentally progressed to 100% because the rollout UI defaulted to "full rollout" after approve. We need safer defaults.
lina: ouch. We had talked about defaulting to a staged wave (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%). Guess it slipped.
ricardo: +1 to staged default. Also want a "severity" field on config changes (low/med/high). High requires explicit multi-approver and cannot default to 100%.
sam: propose defaults: low -> single approver, 1% start. med -> 2 approvers, 1/10/50/100 waves. high -> 2 approvers + org-owner opt-in, 0.1/1/10/100 and auto-block if cost delta > 10%.
ui-team: UI note: show a tiny inline summary bubble in the apply flow: "Wave plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (auto 24h between waves)" and require explicit dropdown to pick a different plan. Also add a lock icon when severity==high.
ricardo: runtime changes: router needs to accept rollout metadata: {rollout_id, wave_percent, severity, start_ts, watch_rules}. Router should prefer rollout-tagged mappings but fallback to active mapping if rollout metadata missing.
ml-telemetry: for watch_rules, we can supply anomaly detectors in addition to static thresholds. e.g., detect unexpected token distribution or repetition spikes. Anomaly triggers count as rollbacks.
lina: good call — we should allow either static thresholds or ML detector ref. UI shows which detectors are attached.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created checklist template: preflight checklist, required approvers, canary tenants list, rollback playbook link. Use `/ops run-rollout-checklist <rollout_id>`.
sam: API naming: POST /v2/configs/preflight -> returns preflight_id with simulated impact. POST /v2/rollouts -> start rollout from a preflight snapshot. PATCH /v2/rollouts/:id/wave -> advance or pause.
ricardo: also add GET /v2/rollouts/:id/progress for live progress and estimated completion ETA. Router needs to emit progress events to kafka so console can draw the bar.
ui-team: console detail: small toast for org admins when a rollout for their org reaches 10% or is paused for >5m. Also show "who approved" and a one-line justification.
ml-telemetry: telemetry should produce a lightweight shadow-compare report: compare baseline responses vs rollout responses for semantic drift and token-entropy. If semantic drift > threshold, mark rollouts suspicious.
lina: security: approver groups are enforced via SSO groups. Service accounts can be allowed to auto-approve only if configured with org policy. The CLI must require `--reason` when using `--force`.
sam: cost estimate: preflight should return an estimated tokens-per-hour delta and CPU/GPU utilization estimate so finance can pre-approve big changes.
ricardo: implementation constraints: preflight snapshots must be immutable (write-once), stored for 90 days, signed by config-service and stored in KMS. Rollout handle includes a rollback_token that ops can use to revert quickly.
ui-team: small UX Q: should the default staged plan include an auto-wait for telemetry gating, or auto-advance on timer?
ml-telemetry: prefer telemetry-gated by default for med/high. Low can be timer-gated. Telemetry-gated means auto-advance only when watch_rules pass for the preceding wave window.
sam: timeline: Lina + Ricardo draft RFC today, UI mocks by Thursday, infra + router changes next sprint. Ops to test rollback playbook in tabletop next Tues.
ops-bot: scheduled tabletop for next Tues 11am PST, posted signup in #eng-oncall.
lina: I'll open the RFC and link mocks. Please drop concrete examples of watch_rules you want in comments.
ricardo: I'll prototype the rollout metadata and kafka events.
ml-telemetry: I'll draft detector configs (template) and an example semantic-drift rule.
sam: thanks. small follow-up: add a non-modal banner in console explaining the new staged defaults and how to opt-out for legacy flows.
ui-team: will add banner copy and a do-not-show checkbox per user.
sam: ok great. Drop +1 on the RFC when ready.
